editorial.blurb: Taste of Egg brings bold, authentic Indian street food to Chicago with a daring focus on egg-based curries and gravies that punch well above their weight.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the egg-centric gravies like spicy tufani or lasan boiled fry—they're what this place does best—and pair with fresh rotis or parathas brushed with ghee that come straight off the tawa.
